core_obligations: Forward: cover the base by affine opens and apply the affine very ampleness criterion on each piece (proof lines 9602-9606).
Reverse: apply the general relative very ampleness lemma (proof lines 9606-9608).
proof_roadmap: Forward implication via an affine covering (proof lines 9602-9606).
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises relatively very ample invertible sheaves for a morphism of finite type by the existence of an open covering of the base over which the sheaf is the pullback of the twisting sheaf along an immersion into a projective space over the piece. The proof obtains the forward implication by taking an affine open covering of the base and applying the affine criterion for very ampleness to each restriction of the morphism and the sheaf, and the reverse implication from the general lemma on relatively very ample sheaves.
